figurative_meaning_en: Hypocrisy; policy full of cunning and deceit
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কূটনীতির ফলে সবাইকে ধোঁকা দেওয়া হলো।
রাজনীতিতে কূটনীতি ছাড়া কাজ চলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His diplomacy full of cunning deceived everyone.
In politics, cunning policy is unavoidable.
note: This term often refers to shrewd or duplicitous diplomatic maneuvers in Bengali political discourse.
